title: Biochemistry as a PEDLER Field
subtitle: Chemistry becomes a biological configuration space

blocks.text: Biochemistry is not simply chemistry plus biology; it is a PEDLER field over an expanded biological configuration space.

blocks.caption: Biochemistry as a PEDLER Field — Chemistry becomes a biological configuration space
blocks.explanation: Chemical correlations provide the substrate while molecular, conformational, electrochemical and informational transitions create the richer field.
